name: Kesh
heading: Kesh, Minor Alteration, Memory Meld, Noble Kesh and Star Kesh
sourceDistinctions: Specialist pp. 97–99, standard language options p. 114, Pilot p. 122, armor p. 132, weapons p. 135, tools p. 142, alter appearance pp. 214–215, shared vision pp. 258–259. Minor Alteration does not give a channeling ability. The sample NPC uses Charisma as a table ruling, following the same species’ explicit Memory Meld ability.

name: Matokai
heading: Matokai, Firetail, Skytalon, Stonefang and Waveclaw
sourceDistinctions: Warrior pp. 103–105, Soldier p. 126, armor p. 132, greataxe p. 135. The introductory fiction depicts a Stonefang’s power axe. This NPC uses the printed greataxe mechanics for its illustrated axe.

name: Promethean
heading: Promethean, Crescent and Fire-Blooded
sourceDistinctions: Specialist pp. 97–99, standard languages p. 114, Techie p. 127, armor p. 132, weapons p. 135, default skill abilities in the character sheet. The Aberrant sidebar describes an exceptional outcome without giving it a playable trait package.
